description: Source code for managing client certificate identities in SSL, including private key handling, certificate setting, and sorting of client certificates based on validity and issuance details.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentity
classes.description: Represents a client SSL certificate identity, manages private keys and intermediates.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentitySorter
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting client certificates based on validity, expiration, issuance, and chain length.

methods.name: IdentityOwningPrivateKeyCallback
methods.description: Callback function that runs when a private key is available, passing it to the provided callback.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentity::SelfOwningAcquirePrivateKey
methods.description: Static method to acquire the private key with ownership of the identity object.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentity::SetIntermediates
methods.description: Sets intermediate certificates for the identity, allowing UTF-8 in printable strings.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentitySorter::operator()
methods.description: Comparison operator to sort client certificates based on validity, expiration, issuance date, and chain length.
